'''Hahn''' is a fifteen year old boy, who has an uncle named [[Almen Bunt]].

==Appearance==

He is tall, with darker coloring like his mother.

==Activities==
He is the son of [[Graeger]] and [[Alysa]] and has a younger brother named [[Adim]]. He carved a set of wooden teeth for his uncle Almen and assisted in saving his mother's apple orchard.

== Trivia ==
* Hahn is named for Adam Hahn, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
